assertions.name: binding_quadratic_negative_norm
assertions.source: decay ghost has negative Gram norm ⇒ binding is quadratic (SDP)

description: decay=binding route for c₃ bar-odd S. Canonical operator-selection LP (t=TR_M,G=Gram,n_target=|tr_M(4₁)|) gives a TRIVIAL dual (active={γ}, binding shadow 0) because the decay ghost ½(L₊−L₋) is TRACELESS (tr_M=0) — invisible to a linear trace-target LP. It has negative Gram norm (−0.4275), so binding is a QUADRATIC (SDP) quantity: mass=linear tr_M, binding=quadratic Gram (mass defect). S is the SDP negative-norm binding form on the ghost; value needs z(q₀). Scope-(a); C14; no c_k wired; no SDP tuned to S.

why_lp_trivial.note: traceless decay mode invisible to linear trace-target LP

binding_is_quadratic.conclusion: binding = quadratic Gram/SDP negative-norm form; mass=linear tr_M; value needs z(q0)
